summary: Iteration 2 (Menu Matrix Editor, Live Happy Hour, Split Payments, Floorplan KPI/Sidebar/Ticker) tested end-to-end. Backend pytest 8/8 passed. Frontend Playwright covers every new data-testid — all passed. Live HH banner appears, cocktails show -25% badge + strikethrough, discounted price flows into ticket (HK$118 -> HK$88.5). Split equal/by_seat/custom flows correctly, pay-confirm disabled when sum<total, split submit succeeds and returns to /floorplan. Floorplan KPI bar renders all six tiles with correct semantics; sidebar-promos updates to show live HH after creation.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/categories and PATCH /api/happy-hours require the FULL body (CategoryIn/HappyHourIn) — a real partial-update would need Optional fields. Not a bug for current UI which always sends the full form, but worth noting for future API consumers.
PATCH /api/happy-hours uses body.model_dump() which will overwrite `active` to model default (True) even if the doc was toggled off elsewhere. Currently no UI toggles active, so harmless.
Split-payment change formula uses `round(paid - o['total'], 2)`; overpay of HK$20 correctly returned change=20.00. Good.
Floorplan KPI polls /tables every 5s and 10s from two effects — could be consolidated. Minor perf nit.
Register component reloads /happy-hours/active on 60s interval; live banner will lag up to 60s when a rule flips. Acceptable.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_* happy_hours/categories then delete. Frontend test created TEST_LIVE_HH, TEST_MATRIX_PRODUCT (Cocktails, +2 variants +1 modifier, HH-eligible), TEST_CAT_UI_EDITED — all cleaned up post-run via authenticated DELETEs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 1 + Iteration 2 both green. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py (run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest -o addopts= <file>` — the project pytest.ini otherwise injects xdist which is fine but xdist workers need REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported in shell env, not just conftest). Preview URL: https://hk-bar-pos-pro.preview.emergentagent.com. KPI-day toggles based on HK hour (>=11 or <6 = OPEN); at 07:50 HK it correctly shows CLOSED.
